verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It chooses a maximum-length trail, uses the even-degree hypothesis to show that the trail must be closed, and then uses connectedness, cyclic rotation of the closed trail, and maximality to show that no edge can be omitted. Every hypothesis is used, the reasoning remains valid when loops are allowed, and there are no prohibited citations, unproven conditional premises, vague external appeals, reference defects, or missing justifications.
